999008199.text:
シトリン、食器洗いを手伝いましょう！
料理とは片付けまで含めてですから――

localizations.en: Citrine, come help with the dishes! Cooking includes cleaning up after yourself—

999008199.text:
はいはい。あーあ、やろうと思ってたのに
なんか急にやる気なくなってきたな

localizations.en: Yeah, yeah. Ugh, I was just about to do that... now I don't feel like it anymore.

999008199.text: まったく、食べ終わっても賑やかだこと

localizations.en: Even after the meal, this lot never quiets down.

999008199.text:
聞いたぜ。この人数の家族をまとめ上げて
宴会やったんだってな？

localizations.en: So I heard you pulled the whole family together and threw a feast? All these people?

999008199.text:
ん、まあね。ヘルトのこともあったし……
それに、兄弟でまた揉めるのはごめんだから

localizations.en: Yeah, more or less. After everything with Held... I didn't want any more fighting between us.

999008199.text:
そうだな。家族仲良しでいられたら、
それが一番だ

localizations.en: That's the right call. A family that gets along—can't ask for more than that.

999008199.text: しかし家族会を開いたり、お前も成長したもんだな

localizations.en: Organizing a family gathering like this though... you've really grown, haven't you.

999008199.text: へへ、どーもぉ

いいかい、しつこい汚れを落とすにはコツがあるんだ。
こうやってね……

localizations.en: Now, the trick to getting stubborn stains off is all in the technique. You do it like this...

999008199.text:
わ、すごい……！
イェルカ姉貴、なんでも知ってるね！

localizations.en: Wow...! You know everything, don't you!

999008199.text:
なんかね、こうして九偉人みんなで過ごすの、
初めてのことじゃない気がするの

localizations.en: You know... spending time like this with all nine of us together... it doesn't quite feel like the first time.

999008199.text:
記憶にはないんだけど、これと似たようなことが
前にもあったような……みたいな？

localizations.en: I can't remember it, but it feels like something like this happened before... like a feeling, you know?

999008199.text:
思い出せそうで思い出せない……
あとちょっとなんだけど。もどかしいなって

localizations.en: It's right on the tip of my tongue, but I just can't reach it. So close... it's maddening.

999008199.text:
そうか。そこまで記憶の蓋が開きかけてるのなら
きっと何かのきっかけで思い出せるさ

localizations.en: Well, if the lid on those memories is already starting to crack open, I'm sure something'll set it loose eventually.

999008199.text: ん、だといいけど……

大丈夫だって。お前はあれだろ？
伝説の九偉人の一人なんだから

localizations.en: You'll be fine. You're one of the legendary Miraculous Nine, remember?

999008199.text: 九偉人と記憶が戻ることには関係がないと思うけど？

localizations.en: I'm pretty sure being one of the Nine has nothing to do with getting my memories back.

999008199.text:
そりゃそうなんだが……大した奴なんだから、
記憶だってわけなく戻っちまうさって言いてえんだよ

localizations.en: Maybe not, but... what I mean is, you're no ordinary person. Something like that'll come back to you easy enough.

999008199.text: 励ますのへったくそね

るせぇ、海の男は背中で語るんだよ。
こういうのは向いてねえんだ

localizations.en: Yeah, yeah. A sailor speaks through his actions, not his words. This stuff ain't exactly my strong suit.

999008199.text:
まあ、その、あれだ。お前が大した奴で
九偉人の一人だったとしてもだ

localizations.en: Look, what I'm trying to say is... even if you are one of the Nine, even if you're some legendary being...

999008199.text:
俺もフロッケもハイディも、お前のこと
家族だって思ってっからよ

localizations.en: Me, Flocke, Heidi—we all think of you as family.

999008199.text: なに、どうしたの？　娘を嫁に出す親父の気分？

localizations.en: What's gotten into you? You sound like a dad sending his daughter off to get married.

999008199.text: お前なあ、茶化すなっての。俺は結構真剣に……

localizations.en: Would you quit joking around? I'm being serious here...

999008199.text:
大丈夫よ、多分。兄弟と仲良くなっても
記憶が完全に戻ったとしても……

localizations.en: I know. And I'll be okay. Even if I grow closer to my siblings, even if all my memories come back...

999008199.text: 私が帰る家は、ここだから

localizations.en: This is where I come home to.
